headline: prediction-markets-explained rises 64 to 77; legal-explainers debuts at 86
paragraphs: Biggest score move since yesterday: prediction-markets-explained rose from 64 to 77 as its breakout rate went from 42% to 49%. remote-work-digital-nomad rose from 61 to 67; lofi-study-music fell from 70 to 65. First scores today: legal-explainers 86, car-explainers 74.

Legal-explainers rests on one channel: 10 of its top 12 videos come from Logic vs. Liability (1,790 subscribers). In car-explainers, 3 of the top 12 are Forever Engine teardown videos. Typical best outlier in prediction-markets-explained rose from 3.9x to 4.6x.

Notable outliers: TC Trading's Kalshi Short at 16,240.6x (17,588,544 views, 60,700 subscribers) and Afterpast's cheapest-town story at 347.5x (3,683,719 views, 20,500 subscribers). No niches added today. Thumbnails not viewable; titles only.
